result.requirement: The system shall prevent the creation of an Order Request if the customer's delivery address falls outside the active boundaries of any defined Service Area Definition.
result.business_need: The business needs to enforce strict geofencing to ensure operational feasibility and prevent accepting orders that cannot be physically fulfilled within the hyperlocal zones.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve the precise geographic coordinates or polygon boundaries for all active Service Area Definitions associated with the Store Partner.
The system shall calculate the spatial relationship between the customer's delivery address and the defined Service Area boundaries.
The system shall block the Order Request submission and display a specific error message if the address is not contained within any valid zone.
The system shall allow the Order Request creation only if the delivery address is confirmed to be inside at least one active Service Area Definition.
The system shall validate the Service Area Definition status in real-time to ensure the zone is currently active for order acceptance.
related_information_requirements: The precise geographic coordinates, radii, or polygon boundaries defining the specific zones where the platform is authorized to operate.
Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers and delivery addresses.
business_rules: An order must not be created if the delivery address is geographically outside all active Service Area Definitions.
A Service Area Definition must be marked as active to allow order placement within its boundaries.
The system must validate the delivery address against the Service Area Definition at the moment of order submission.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to place an order with a delivery address inside an active Service Area Definition
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the Order Request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system allows the order creation and proceeds to the next step

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to place an order with a delivery address outside all defined Service Area Definitions
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the Order Request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system blocks the order creation and displays a message indicating the address is outside the service area
